name: Finance Controller Absence During Period Close
description: Simulates the systemic impact of the Finance Controller being on unexpected leave during the fiscal period close, resulting in a 4x wait time for all steps where they are the sole Approver (A) or Accountable (RACI) role.

shocks.rationale: Manual journals >$50k pile up awaiting Controller sign-off.
Top-side consolidation adjustments delayed due to absence of Controller.
Final sign-off and disclosure routing completely stalled without the Controller.
